Trace, implement and test: 面试题13. 机器人的运动范围

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int movingCount(int m, int n, int k) {
        bool vis[m][n];
        memset(vis, false, sizeof vis);
        auto f = [](int x) {
            return x / 10 + x % 10;
        };
        function<int(int i, int j)> dfs = [&](int i, int j) -> int {
            if (i < 0 || i >= m || j < 0 || j >= n || vis[i][j] || f(i) + f(j) > k) {
                return false;
            }
            vis[i][j] = true;
            return 1 + dfs(i + 1, j) + dfs(i, j + 1);
        };
        return dfs(0, 0);
    }
};
